{"ticket": "I can't log into Northbeam anymore, I’ve been trying to reset my password for over an hour now and it just keeps looping me back to the login screen, and honestly I’m so stressed because I just had a meeting with Dr. Patel and we were going to review the patient intake forms, and I can't remember if I set up the new billing template last week or not, and also I don’t know if my phone got lost in the office parking lot, and I'm not sure if I should just buy a new 2FA app or if it's still linked to my old one that I used on the old system, and I've also been thinking about switching to a different practice management software, but I don't want to lose all our patient data and I’ve heard Northbeam is better with insurance claims, and I don’t even know if my SSO is still configured correctly because I changed the email address when I joined, and I think the admin said something about it being auto-synced but I can’t verify that, and I just feel like I’m missing something big here, and I can’t even send a message to the team to check in on the next appointment schedule, it’s just so frustrating and I swear I’ve been here before and I think I used to have a backup login, but I can’t find it in the settings, and I’m not sure if I should call my IT guy or just try to reset everything again, and honestly I don’t know what to do, I just need to get back in so I can finish the monthly report for the board meeting, and I’ve already sent three emails to support and I haven’t gotten a reply yet, and I feel like I’m being ignored, and I can’t even check my dashboard to see if the patient list is updated or if there’s a new appointment scheduled, and I can’t even do a quick export of yesterday’s visits to show the team, it’s like the whole thing is just broken for me, and I don’t know if this is a security issue or just a login problem, but I’m worried someone might have accessed my account from outside, I don’t know how to tell the difference, and I think I should report it but I don’t know if it’s a breach or just a bad password reset, and I just need to get back in so I can send the emails to the front desk and the billing team, and I don’t know if I can even do that without

{"ticket": "I'm completely lost and everyone in the office is just staring at the screen like it's a ghost show — no login, no dashboards, nothing, I’ve tried the phone, the browser, even incognito, and the login page just spins and dies, and I can’t even get into Slack to tell my team we’re in a crisis, I keep thinking about switching to BrightFlow because they seem to have better uptime, but honestly this is a disaster, I’ve been here for 3 hours trying to figure out what happened, and I just can’t get anyone in, not even the receptionist who used to use the old system, and I’m starting to worry that the billing team will be blocked too, but that’s not the main thing — the main thing is that the whole team is stuck, totally unreachable, like the app just evaporated overnight, and I don’t know if I should call IT or just scream into the void, I’ve already told the assistant on the phone that we’re considering BrightFlow, but really, the app is just not loading for anyone, even after refreshing, and I don’t see any error codes, it’s just a blank screen and a spinning wheel that never stops, and it’s affecting the whole practice, not just one person, so it’s not a password or a device issue, it’s like the entire system is down, and I’m so stressed I almost forgot to take the lunch break, which is a dumb thing to do, but seriously, I can’t function without access, and I feel like this is a total failure, and I’m not even sure if we’ll be able to do the end-of-month billing if we can’t see the schedule or the patient logs, which is worse than anything I’ve ever seen, so I’m just writing this because I’m literally panicking and I have no idea what to do next, and frankly, I can’t believe we’re still on Northbeam after all this chaos.", "category": "outage", "priority": "P1", "rationale": "The ticket describes whole-team unavailability with the app not loading for anyone, which qualifies as an outage under the policy, and all outage tickets are P1."}

{"ticket": "Need all client data exported. Also want access logs from last quarter.", "category": "data_request", "priority": "P3", "rationale": "All data_request tickets are assigned P3 under the policy"}
